claims.statement: K&S's own FY2025 10-K: it is a semiconductor assembly equipment maker and a majority of its revenue comes from wire bonding; its ball and wedge bonders are manufactured in Singapore. Supplier self-report; no share, customer or end use is given in these passages.

claims.statement: K&S's FY2025 10-K says that with APAMA, APAMA Plus and APTURA it is developing and manufacturing advanced packaging solutions for 2.5D and 3D IC markets, and that its fluxless direct-copper thermo-compression bonder positions it for chiplet-based advanced packages; these tools are built in Singapore. Supplier self-report: no advanced-packaging customer, qualification or volume is named, and the segment that sells these tools (Advanced Solutions) is loss-making in the 2026 10-Q.

sources.quote: Kulicke and Soffa Industries, Inc. (“K&S,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) is a global leader in semiconductor assembly technology, advancing device performance across automotive, compute, industrial, memory and communications markets.
Given that a majority of our revenue comes from wire bonding, a reduced demand for our wire bonding equipment could materially and adversely affect our financial results.

With the launch of our APAMATM, APAMA PlusTM and APTURATM, we are also developing and manufacturing advanced packaging solutions for the emerging 2.5-dimensional integrated circuit (“2.5D IC”) and 3-dimensional integrated circuit (“3D IC”) markets.

The APTURATM is a highly capable thermo-compression bonding system which supports an ultra-fine-pitch fluxless direct-copper thermo-compression bonding process. With this system, we are well positioned to enable growth of chiplet-based advanced packages.
Our ball bonder, wedge bonder, AT Premier series, APAMATM, APAMA PlusTM, APTURATM and KatalystTM bonder manufacturing and assembly is done at our facility in Singapore.
